description: NaNi₄(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.70 Å. There are three inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-45°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.38 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-45°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.45 Å. In the third Ni site, Ni is bonded to five O atoms to form NiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four NiO₆ octahedra, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 65-75°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.11 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-64°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ni and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ni and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Ni and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONi₃P tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Ni and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONi₃P tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ni and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ni and one P atom.
